name: oct-16-25
note: Fri Oct 16 to Sun Oct 25, both channels. Instagram: two 7-day windows, each with a reel and a carousel; the Thursday send-this post (manifest/send-this.json) sits in window 1 and is merged with --with for the gate. Pinterest: one pin a day; five pins go to the two live recipe pages (kids dinners, 10-minute breakfasts; every number copied from ieatz-social pages/content/*.json), five are product or recipe pins to the App Store because no new page can go live inside 9 days. Rejected photos this batch (opened, not used): fridge-warm-open and fridge-stocked (soda, Cheez Whiz, wine box, brand labels), mother-child-cooking and mother-child-meal (Hillshire Farm pack in frame), pantry-real-shelves (Nutella, Senseo, Kinder), counter-eggs-prep and woman-in-kitchen (a third-party recipe site on a tablet), family-cooking-together (no 2:3 or 4:5 crop keeps every face). Receipt math: 3.29 + 0.99 + 2.99 + 4.49 + 7.99 + 5.49 = 25.24. Soup and salmon and chickpea bowl recipes are generated here; their protein figures are labeled estimates. Reels are silent: no Meta Sound Collection track has been supplied. Device screens are derived crops of the real app-instacart.jpg and app-recipe.jpg (browser chrome and bottom nav removed, nothing added) so the full screen fits the phone frame.

posts.photoClaim: a cook slicing cherry tomatoes on a wooden board, with scallions, tomatoes, corn and a head of cauliflower on the counter
posts.head: Take a photo of what's on the counter. Dinner is in there.
posts.sub: iEatz reads the photo, lists the ingredients and builds tonight's recipe from them.

posts.photoClaim: glass jars of red lentils, bulgur, split peas and rice on a pantry shelf, and a bowl of roasted chickpeas with greens, edamame, olives, tomato and a wedge of naan
posts.head: Shelf-stable, still dinner

slides.head: Four soups that start on the pantry shelf
slides.body: A can of beans or a cup of lentils, broth, one thing green. Swipe for all four.

items.t: Soften garlic in olive oil
items.s: 3 cloves, sliced, 1 minute. Chili flakes if you have them.

items.t: Add two cans of white beans and 4 cups broth
items.s: Drained. Simmer 10 minutes, then mash a ladleful against the pot to thicken it.

items.t: Wilt in a bunch of kale
items.s: Stems off, torn. 3 minutes. Finish with lemon and parmesan.

items.t: Cook an onion with a spoon of cumin
items.s: Diced, in olive oil, 6 minutes until soft.

items.t: Add crushed tomatoes, chickpeas and broth
items.s: A 28 oz can, a drained can of chickpeas, 3 cups broth. Simmer 15 minutes.

items.t: Stir in spinach at the end
items.s: Two big handfuls. A spoon of yogurt on top if there is some.

items.t: Toast curry powder in oil
items.s: 1 tbsp, 30 seconds, with a chopped onion and 2 cloves garlic.

items.t: Add a cup of red lentils, a can of coconut milk, 3 cups broth
items.s: Simmer 20 minutes, until the lentils fall apart.

items.t: Lime at the end
items.s: Juice of one. Salt to taste. It thickens as it sits.

items.t: Onion, cumin, a little chipotle
items.s: In oil, 5 minutes.

items.t: Two cans of black beans, 3 cups broth
items.s: Drained. Simmer 10 minutes.

items.t: Blend half, pour it back
items.s: Lime juice, and whatever is open: cheese, cilantro, tortilla chips.

slides.head: Four cans, four soups, one pot
slides.body: Save this for the first cold night. Protein and time are estimates per serving.

posts.head: Half the week is on this receipt

slides.photoClaim: two eggs, half an avocado, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, spinach, arugula, a jalapeño and scallions on a cutting board
slides.head: One dozen, three meals
Cheesy egg and black bean quesadillas

items.t: Mash the beans into the eggs
items.s: 1/2 cup black beans, 3 eggs, a pinch of salt. Mashed in, nobody picks them out.

items.t: Scramble until just set
items.s: Butter, medium heat, about 2 minutes. Scrape it out.

items.t: Fold into tortillas with cheese
items.s: 1/2 cup cheddar, 2 minutes a side. Spinach and jalapeño in the grown-up one.

items.t: Cut the kid one into triangles
items.s: Salsa on the side, not on top.

slides.head: Savory oats with a jammy egg

items.t: Boil an egg for 7 minutes
items.s: Then into cold water. Keep the pot boiling.

items.t: Cook 1/2 cup oats in the same water
items.s: 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.

items.t: Cheese, soy, the egg on top
items.s: 2 tbsp parmesan, a splash of soy, scallion and a lot of pepper.

slides.head: Black bean and egg skillet, wrapped

items.t: Warm a can of beans with cumin
items.s: Dry skillet, smash about half of them.

items.t: Crack two eggs into the empty half
items.s: Cover, 3 minutes.

items.t: Warm the tortillas, fill, roll tight
items.s: Salsa, cheese, cilantro, whatever is open.

slides.head: Eggs are the cheapest protein in the fridge
slides.body: All three recipes are free on ieatzhealthy.com/recipes. Protein is per serving.

posts.photoClaim: a bowl of seared salmon over cauliflower rice with green beans, cherry tomatoes and pesto, pine nuts scattered around
posts.head: Pesto salmon over cauliflower rice
posts.method: Sear the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes, flip for 3. Steam the beans and the cauliflower rice in the same pan with a splash of water, 5 minutes. Spoon pesto over the salmon, scatter the tomatoes and pine nuts.
